summary: M2 claw_remember: owner MCP « retiens ça » capture into the S24 shared memory through the canonical context-event.sh writer
reason: Doc 49 P0-M2: MCP surfaces (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) never write durable facts; memory.db only holds chat, work and openclaw events.

tests.name: m2-remember
tests.evidence: scripts/test-mcp-remember.cjs (in CI): real context-event.sh/context-store.py in an isolated root, c10 S24 memory.db schema, identity surfaces, receipt replay without re-dispatch, conflict, claw_status, supersession, secret refusal, transcript/kind/owner guards, bridge owner gate, 200 000 events under 5 s.

tests.name: relay-mcp-catalog
tests.evidence: cloud/voice-relay/test-mcp.mjs: owner catalog lists claw_remember with closed kinds and no surface argument, shadow catalog unchanged, stable request id, pending running state on device_timeout.

fixtures: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/fixtures/s24-2026-10-12/m2/context-writer.json (new read-only S24 capture: installed context-event.sh hash identical to repo, memory.db events schema, counts by surface)
openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/fixtures/s24-2026-10-10/c10/memory-events-200.json (existing sanitized S24 capture: events schema and kinds)

capabilities.reason: NO_CAPABILITY: MCP owner primitive feeding the existing memory.cross_surface owner; no Companion HTTP route, no app or voice action.

architecture.reason: Reuses context-event.sh/memory.db and Remote Bridge receipts; no new store, registry, router, scheduler or daemon.

mcp_owner_parity.reason: claw_remember added for chat-owner only; claw_status reads its receipt with the same keys.

rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy Companion and relay; events already written stay in memory.db as ordinary context events (forget via memory control).
limitations: No deployment and no live claw_remember qualification on the S24 in this lot (S24 reads were strictly read-only).
Companion and relay must be deployed together; the relay alone would expose a tool the device rejects as unsupported_mcp_tool.
End-of-turn capture proposals for Companion/voice and SOUL/USER edit events (rest of M2) are not in this lot.
